title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
A 23-year-old Chinese student is on trial in Zurich for attempted murder after stabbing three five-year-old boys outside a daycare in Oerlikon on 1 October 2024. Using a knife with an 8.5 centimetre blade, he seriously wounded all three. One boy needed emergency surgery after a major vein at his collarbone was cut, another suffered two chest wounds that damaged his heart and arteries and nearly died, and the third was injured on his ear and lung. A daycare worker grabbed the attacker's arms, forcing him to drop the knife, and passersby held him until police arrived.

Prosecutors say the man planned the attack for weeks. He asked ChatGPT about legal consequences of stabbing random victims, chose children, ordered knives and clothing, studied anatomy, and bought raw beef to practise stabbing. He acted on China's national day and posted patriotic messages beforehand. The prosecution calls the crime cold-blooded and is asking for a 15-year prison sentence and a 15-year expulsion from Switzerland. The trial began Thursday.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
